description: State that exists only until an action completes or is cancelled, such as a form draft. Belongs to the form, not to a global store.
The DOM owns the value (`defaultValue`, read with `FormData` or refs). No re-render per keystroke.
React 19 hook returning `[state, formAction, isPending]`; the action receives the previous state and the `FormData`.
Form library built on uncontrolled inputs with `register`, subscription-based `formState`, `useWatch` and schema resolvers.
Deliberately saving a draft (keyed by entity id) to storage or a store when it must survive navigation or reload.
